Desert Skate Specter.text: Guaranteed reward from Baro Void-Signal missions.

Aoi Accolade Glyph.text: Earned by defeating the H-09 Apex Hardmode Boss alone on Steel Path while using Aoi's depicted Warframe, Mag.

Arthur Accolade Glyph.text: Earned by defeating the H-09 Apex Hardmode Boss alone on Steel Path while using Arthur's depicted Warframe, Excalibur.

Albrecht's Treasures Glyph.text: Previously available through the Sanctum Supporter Pack until September 9, 2024.

Bird 3 Sketch Glyph.text: Purchase from Bird 3 during Operation: Atramentum for 15 Nightmare Tatters.
